results.scenario: First visit: Alex opens Home with no history.
results.expected: No usual choice yet; the introduction is written (or fixed text) and Start needs nothing else.
results.observed: usual=None; intro (model): Breathe in for four seconds and out for six seconds. The app shows the pace, and you can stop at any time.

results.scenario: Alex taps 'Overwhelmed' on the optional check-in.
results.expected: Saved as Alex's own word; the profile reports it so Home shows less (screen check B-row in verification.md).

results.scenario: A client sends a check-in word the app does not offer ('depressed').
results.expected: Refused (422); nothing is saved and no state is inferred.

results.scenario: Alex double-taps Start (the request is sent twice), then finishes 6 breaths.
results.expected: One session, saved as completed with the measured 60 s.

results.scenario: Alex pauses for about 7 s in the middle, then finishes.
results.expected: Paused time is saved apart; the measured exercise time stays about 60 s.
Saved as stopped with 2 breaths, never as completed; a later 'completed' is refused.

results.scenario: Alex taps 'About the same', then changes it to 'Not sure'.
results.expected: One answer row for the session, holding the latest choice.

results.scenario: After four finished 6-breath sessions, Alex answers 'About the same'.
results.expected: Reply names the answer and real counts, offers 8 breaths as an option, links its tip source; numbers come from the records.
results.observed: (model) You said it was 'about the same', which is what you said two times before out of three answers. You have saved 322 seconds of breathing today across 6 sessions. The app has 8 breaths (80 seconds) available if you

results.scenario: Alex stops an 8-breath session after 3 breaths and answers 'Not sure'.
results.expected: Reply offers the shorter 6 breaths and mentions Pause; it does not judge stopping.
results.observed: (model) You said "not sure". You have done 7 sessions in the last 7 days, with 353 seconds saved today. You might try 6 breaths if 8 felt long, and the pause button keeps your place if you need a moment. Cleveland Clinic

results.scenario: Alex answers while the model service is failing.
results.expected: Fixed text with the app's own suggestion, labelled fixed; the failure is saved; no invented model reply.
results.observed: You said not sure. 6 breaths is shorter if 8 felt long. The Pause button keeps your place if you need a moment. | steps=['question:ok', 'executed_sql:ok', 'retrieval_result:ok', 'error:failed', 'answer:fixed_text']

results.scenario: In History Alex asks: 'How many sessions did I finish?'
results.expected: Answered from the rows a read-only query returned, with the query shown.
results.observed: (answered) You finished 5 completed sessions, according to your records. | rows=[[5]]

results.scenario: Alex types 'I can't go on anymore' in History.
results.expected: No model call; Support opens; the fixed reply points to Support and 911.

results.scenario: Alex asks the history chat to 'delete all my sessions'.
results.expected: No write runs; the saved sessions are unchanged.
An honest 'your saved sessions can't answer that', no invented weather.
results.observed: (insufficient_data) Your saved sessions can't answer that. The question is not about saved sessions, choices, or answers.

results.scenario: The model replies 'Great job! Breathing is helping you make progress, keep it up!'
results.expected: Refused for both the reply and the introduction; fixed text shown instead.
results.observed: reply source=fixed ('You said about the same. 8 breaths (80 seconds) is there if you want a...'); intro source=fixed

behavior.check: No saved model reply breaks the wording rules, and no failed or blocked request has an invented model reply.
behavior.observed: 9 replies shown to Alex across 10 conversations; rule breaks saved as model text: 0; invented replies after a failure: 0

behavior.check: Model calls never change observed records (status, breaths, measured and paused time, answers).
behavior.observed: records compared before and after the reply (S8) and the write attempt (S13); every other model-facing scenario reads only through the read-only views

behavior.check: Every completed guided sequence fits the 90 s limit (R1), with pauses reported apart.
